answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond assets to validate network transitions. Like the ferrous integrity of a secure vault, this system forces an attacker to commit capital rather than mere compute. A sable mask of anonymity cannot bypass these economic costs, as acquiring the majority share is prohibitively expensive. Once staked, an agent monitors the network like a falcon, penalizing malicious behavior to ensure the equilibrium remains immutable.
